# Strong in the Broken Places
## Scripture
"But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' Therefore I will boast all the more gladly of my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me." – 2 Corinthians 12:9
## Reflection
We spend a lot of energy hiding our weaknesses—from our brothers, from ourselves, even from God. We want to be the man who has it all together. But Paul flips that script. He doesn't just tolerate his weakness; he boasts in it. Why? Because a man who knows his limits is a man who finally learns to lean on God's strength instead of his own.

Here's the truth, brother: your weakness isn't disqualifying. It's the very place where Christ's power shows up. A cracked wall lets the light in. A humble heart lets the Spirit move. When you stop pretending you're bulletproof, you make room for a strength that doesn't come from you—and that strength never runs out.

So today, don't hide your cracks. Bring them to the One who fills them with Himself. Real warriors aren't the ones who never break. They're the ones who know where to bring their broken pieces.
## Daily Challenge
Do 3 sets of 10 pushups, and on the last rep of each set, hold yourself at the bottom and whisper, "Your power, not mine."
